description: The edge decayed: five years of backtest at Sharpe 2.0 and 1.5 years live at Sharpe 0.0 (the shadow backtest tracks live, so the model itself stopped working).
comment: Backtest Sharpe exactly 2.0 on 1260 days, live exactly 0.0 on 378 days: PSR of the live Sharpe against 2.0 is about 0.007; two-sample t of the mean shift about -2.15. The CUSUM at h = 5 does not cross for a shift of 0.126 sd per day; the mean-shift test carries the structural-break alert.
